phase: Phase 3 - RAG query rewriting and deterministic reranking
objective: Improve answer quality by improving what context reaches DeepSeek: normalize queries, rewrite command/category questions, collect multi-query candidates, rerank deterministically, and prove before/after eval improvement.
deliverables: Added lib/rag/query-planning.ts with intent detection, slash-command expansion, preferred source hints, and rewritten search queries.
Added lib/rag/reranking.ts with deterministic reranking, source-priority policy, query-term overlap, preferred-source overlap, and keyword-score boost.
Updated lib/rag/retrieval.ts to use multi-query candidate retrieval and reranking before answer generation.

Persisted retrieval metadata: original_query, rewritten_queries, query_intent, query_planner_version, reranker_version, source_priority_policy, selected_source_types, rerank scores, and rerank reasons.
Added unit coverage for query planning, source priority, and reranker ordering.
Ran RAG smoke, RAG answer smoke, /ask-sage smoke, full eval, smoke eval, typecheck, unit tests, and production build.

commands.notes: Returned 5 results with Discord community/runbook sources.
Next build completed. Existing academy dynamic-server-usage warnings appeared and did not fail the build.

honestResult.reason: The full eval improved from 35/50 to 44/50 and all required Phase 3 exit metrics improved or stayed stable.
